high_level_description: The image is a news article headline from the Times of India, dated one day ago. The headline reads: "Paying schoolgirls to have babies: Russia gives financial incentives for teen mothers- part of worldwide." The background features a large building under construction, with scaffolding covering much of its facade. There is also a statue or sculpture visible on a pedestal behind her.
